chains.title: FOXA1 binds the ref allele at an unannotated element and affects ENSG00000259868

links.claim: FOXA1 would need to bind the ref C allele more strongly; no positive motif, SELEX, MPRA, or reporter evidence is provided, and ENCODE FOXA1 ChIP-seq shows no FOXA1 peak containing the variant in MCF7 (E08).
This requires an unannotated intronic element, but E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap; absence of annotation is not positive evidence for a functional element.

The only genetic signal is a weak credible-set molecular QTL for ENSG00000259868 with PIP 0.03 in brain nucleus accumbens (E05), and GTEx breast tissue shows no significant eQTL for this variant (E09).
The eQTL is in brain nucleus accumbens, not MCF7 (E05), and FOXA1 ChIP-seq has no peak at the variant in MCF7 (E08), so breast-cell relevance is unproven.
There is no GWAS association for rs11629191 (E04), so a breast-cancer effect through ENSG00000259868 is only speculative.

predictions: FOXA1 ChIP-seq or EMSA shows stronger binding to the ref C allele.
ENSG00000259868 expression is allele-dependent in the relevant cell type.
Editing the variant changes ENSG00000259868 expression.
falsified_if: FOXA1 binds equally to both alleles or not at all.
ENSG00000259868 is not expressed or not allele-dependent in the relevant cell type.
The element is not active in MCF7.

chains.title: ESR1 binds the alt allele in a cryptic intronic enhancer and affects PELI2

links.claim: ESR1 would need to bind the alt T allele more strongly; no positive motif, SELEX, MPRA, or reporter evidence is provided, and ENCODE FOXA1/ESR1 ChIP-seq shows no ESR1 peak containing the variant in MCF7 (E07).

This requires a cryptic intronic enhancer, but E01 reports an intron_variant with no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap, with the nearest dELS 1868 bp away; the evidence argues against an annotated element.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb upstream, but the only credible-set molecular QTL is for ENSG00000259868, not PELI2 (E05), and GTEx breast tissue shows no significant eQTL for this variant (E09).

MCF7 is the stated expression context, but no MCF7-specific regulatory or expression evidence supports this chain; ESR1 ChIP-seq has no peak at the variant in MCF7 (E07), and the only eQTL is in brain nucleus accumbens (E05).
rs11629191 has no GWAS Catalog association (E04), and the PELI2 literature hits (E06) do not provide variant-specific or allele-specific breast-cancer evidence.

predictions: ESR1 ChIP-seq or EMSA shows stronger binding to the alt T allele.
PELI2 expression is allele-dependent in MCF7 or other estrogen-receptor-positive breast cells.
Editing the variant changes PELI2 expression or a breast-cancer phenotype.
falsified_if: ESR1 binds equally to both alleles or not at all.
No PELI2 expression change is seen with allele or editing.
The region is inactive in MCF7.
